title: Split read-only inspection from Vaporize mutation
description: Establish vaporize-inspect as the read-only product boundary while Vaporize retains explicit materialization and mutation commands.
acceptanceCriteria: A separately buildable release product named vaporize-inspect.cli-s@wrkstrm-core.coll owns operator-facing inspection.
The first inspection reports SwiftPM bin PATH state, platform, canonical bin path, persistence surface, and remediation without changing host state.
Windows identifies HKCU\Environment\Path and macOS identifies the selected shell profile.
Vaporize retains the explicit path add-swiftpm-bin mutation and uses inspection only as an internal install postcondition.
New operational output uses CommonLog, new shared Swift code adds no conditional-compilation branch, and focused Windows tests pass.

evidence.tests: swift test --scratch-path C:\b\t\vaporize-inspect-split --filter VaporizeInspectCLITests: 3 tests passed on x86_64 Windows
evidence.boundary: This slice establishes the product and PATH inspection. Migrating other historical read-only Vaporize commands is follow-on work.

resolution: Added a read-only CommonLog-backed inspection executable and kept persistent PATH mutation in Vaporize.
